_contract.cells: floor cells [x, z]: x = column (0 at the left end of a row), z = row (0 = the back row, the door row is the last). +x = screen right-down, +z = screen left-down
_contract.windows: KEYS NAMED BY THE WALL, VALUES ARE THE OTHER AXIS: windows.z = the x indices of the windows on the z = 0 wall (the back-RIGHT wall, along the first row, so 0 < v < rows[0] - 1); windows.x = the z indices of the windows on the x = 0 wall (the back-LEFT wall, along the first column, so 0 < v < len(rows) - 1). windows_by_wall repeats the same two lists under unambiguous names: back_right_z0 (= windows.z), back_left_x0 (= windows.x)
_contract.numbers: every number is a JSON number and arrives as a FLOAT in Godot (JSON.parse_string): compare with int(v), Array.has(int) is false
_contract.door: door.cell = [x, z] on the last row, door.dir = [0, 1] (the door faces +z); spawn_cell is the cell in front of it
_contract.zoom_fit: default interior camera zoom at the 1280x720 base: 0.85 x min(1280/W, 720/H), W = (cols + rows) x 64, H = (cols + rows) x 38 + 280
